themes.name: Education and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals to improve school facilities, teaching, class conditions, or services and benefits delivered specifically to children or school-age students, excluding student housing.

themes.name: Affordable and Efficient Housing
themes.rule: Proposals that increase housing supply, affordability, price transparency, student accommodation, or the energy performance of homes.

themes.name: Public Transit and Active Travel
themes.rule: Proposals to improve the operation, information, availability, or physical infrastructure of public transit, cycling, walking, and road crossings, excluding school-targeted transit benefits.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals focused on waste reduction, recycling, pollution monitoring, renewable energy, energy-related environmental action, urban greening, or community food growing.

themes.name: Culture, Recreation, and Public Amenities
themes.rule: Proposals for cultural access and events or for shared recreational amenities such as parks, playgrounds, libraries, and dog-exercise spaces.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand health care, mental-health support, preventive screening, primary or specialist care, or in-home support for residents.

themes.name: Community Safety and Emergency Response
themes.rule: Proposals aimed at preventing crime, improving street safety through lighting, strengthening neighborhood policing or surveillance, or reducing emergency-response times.

themes.name: Digital City Services and Access
themes.rule: Proposals that make city services, civic information, connectivity, or assistance with digital services easier to access through online tools, public Wi-Fi, or service channels.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers, job seekers, local hiring, business finance, shared workspaces, business regulation, or career reskilling.
